comparison.objective: Assemble three eccentrically weighted bars into an ordered balance chain on a narrow pedestal.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered stacking/assembly, balance prediction, precision placement, and long released stabilization.
comparison.success_condition: Correct ordered chain remains self-supported without robot contact for 20 seconds; exact pose and contact thresholds are absent from the available body.
comparison.reason: Dynamic load balancing of intact bars differs from controlled localized fracture using two tools and subsequent recovery of four millimetre-scale fragments.
